tools.name: search_teaching_jobs
tools.description: Search live education jobs on EduAtlas: teaching and leadership posts at schools worldwide, support roles (marked), and posts at universities and education organisations. Free text works: "physics teacher London", "IB maths Dubai", "SENCO", "Lehrperson Zürich". The word "IB" limits results to IB Wor

tools.name: schools_hiring
tools.description: Which schools are hiring right now in a country (optionally a city, and a subject or role word), ranked by number of live vacancies. Answers "which schools in Leeds are recruiting science teachers" with school names, counts and page URLs.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_teaching_jobs, get_school · Private data: get_school, find_jobs_for_me · Public sink: search_teaching_jobs, get_school, find_jobs_for_me.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_teaching_jobs, get_school · Private data: get_school, find_jobs_for_me · Public sink: search_teaching_jobs, get_school, find_jobs_for_me

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_teaching_jobs" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
